purpose: One controlled roadside-vehicle false-hazard-warning example plus real-obstacle guards. Not a general false-positive-rate benchmark.
timing: Fixed 30 fps simulation capture. No video retiming. Each run recorded for 22 seconds.

baseline.type: Simple monocular image-box warning with shared known-route following
baseline.limitation: These manually chosen parameters and the controlled scene are illustrative; this is not a comparison against all vision-only systems.

cases.name: 14-roadside-vision-only
cases.timing: Fixed 30 fps simulation capture for presentation. Paired fixed 22-second recordings. The simple vision-only baseline uses image boxes; both controllers share route following. No metric distance enters the vision-only warning decision.
cases.overlayProvenance: Model-view RGB held from the exact inference input; JSON boxes are native Unity model outputs for that same input. No ground-truth boxes.
